newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian and Saudi energy officials meet in Moscow.
newsitem.headline: Russian and Saudi energy officials meet in Moscow.

text.p: Russian Fuel and Energy Minister Boris Nemtsov met a senior Saudi oil official on Tuesday and will probably lead a delegation of domestic producers to the Gulf state this autumn, Prime-Tass news agency said on Tuesday.
Nemstov, a reformer who is also a first deputy prime minister, met Saudi First Deputy Oil Minister Prince Abdul-Aziz bin Salman for talks, the agency said.
"The huge investment potential of Saudi companies could find an application in Russia," Interfax news agency quoted Nemtsov as saying.
No details on the talks were immediately available.
Neither Saudi Arabia, the world's largest oil producer, nor Russia, the third-largest producer behind the United States, have invested significantly in each other's energy sectors.
